QuestInfo.name: Crescent Emblem
QuestInfo.0: Shingen has a gift for you.
QuestInfo.1: Shingen has a gift for you.
QuestInfo.2: Shingen has given you an Emblem.

0.0: Welcome, #b#h0##k. I still remember the day when you first held a sword.
0.1: We accomplished a great deal since then, and it's thanks to all your hard work.
0.2: This is a item I prepared just for you. It's very special, so only special people can have it. I think it's called an #bEmblem#k in this world. Here, take it.

no.0: But you deserve it! Please allow me to give you a small token of my gratitude.

yes.0: The stars will always guide you. I look forward to seeing what you do in the future.\r\n
